Bandpass.Description: Built-in amplifier band pass 0.15 to 200 Hz, 1-pole, so no sharp corner at 200 Hz; amplitude roll-off function in ns_1k_1_300_filt.mat (speech_basic README (SDR zk881ps0522)).

TaskDescription: Verb generation (acq-verbs): written nouns (about 2.5 cm high, 8-12 cm wide) shown on a screen about 1 m away; the patient speaks a verb connected to the noun; 1.6 s cues alternate with a 1.6 s blank-screen interstimulus interval. Noun reading control task (acq-nouns): the patient reads each noun aloud. Audio of patient speech is not included. (speech_basic README; Miller et al. 2011 J Neurosurg Pediatr doi:10.3171/2011.2.PEDS1156)
Instructions: Verb generation: speak a verb that was connected to the noun (e.g. cue 'ball' -> 'kick', 'bee' -> 'fly'); control task: read each noun as it appears (speech_basic README).
iEEGPlacementScheme: Subdural ECoG electrodes; grid location per source patient table kjm_ECoGLibrary_PatientTaskTable.pdf: L Fronto-temporal-parietal
